listeningQuestions.audio: The explorer brought every man home alive after two years on the ice.
opts: 在冰上的两年后,探险者把每个人都活着带回了家。
探险者独自一人逃回了家。
船员们全都留在了岛上。
探险者用了两天就回家了。

listeningQuestions.audio: The ship was crushed by the ice before it finally sank.
opts: 这艘船被冰压碎后最终沉没。
这艘船安全地回到了港口。

listeningQuestions.audio: No one had ever crossed the island on foot before that day.
opts: 在那天之前从没有人徒步穿越过这座岛。
很多人常常徒步穿越这座岛。
他们坐船绕过了这座岛。

listeningQuestions.audio: Great efforts were being made when the storm suddenly hit the boat.
opts: 风暴突然袭来时,人们正在做巨大的努力。
风暴来时大家都在睡觉。

listeningQuestions.audio: Modern explorers can call for rescue by radio if something goes wrong.
opts: 如果出了问题,现代探险者能用无线电求救。
现代探险者从不带任何装备。
现代探险者不会遇到危险。
现代探险者只能徒步回家。

listeningQuestions.audio: Real courage is often shown in how we deal with failure.
opts: 真正的勇气常常体现在我们如何面对失败。
勇敢的人从不感到害怕。
失败的人都不值得记住。

幸存、渡过难关,用哪个词?
卓越的、杰出的,用哪个词?

quizQuestions.q: Great efforts ____ to free the ship when the ice broke.
quizQuestions.point: 过去进行被动 were being done

quizQuestions.q: The route ____ on foot by anyone before that day.

quizQuestions.point: 过去进行被动 was being done

opts: 他们在冰上扎营,缓缓向北漂去。
他们游到了最近的城市。
quizQuestions.audio: They camped on the ice and drifted slowly north.

opts: 如果在严寒中睡着,他们可能再也醒不来。
他们随时都能停下来好好睡一觉。
天气太热让他们睡不着。
他们坐着船一直在睡觉。
quizQuestions.audio: If they fell asleep in the cold, they might never wake up.

reading.passage: Shackleton's most famous journey was, in a way, a failure: his ship was lost in the ice and he never reached the land he set out to cross. Yet he is remembered as a hero, because his calm leadership brought every member of the crew home alive.
reading.passageCn: 从某种意义上说,沙克尔顿最著名的旅程是一次失败:他的船在冰中失踪,他始终没能到达想要横穿的陆地。然而他被铭记为英雄,因为他沉着的领导力把全体船员都活着带回了家。

questions.q: Why is the journey called a failure?
opts: His ship was lost and he never reached his goal.
All his men died on the ice.
He gave up after one day.
He refused to lead the crew.

questions.q: Why is Shackleton remembered as a hero?
opts: His leadership brought everyone home alive.
He found gold on the ice.

writing.prompt: Write about 60 words on an explorer or adventure you admire: who or what it is, one thing that makes the story amazing, and why you find it inspiring.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词写一位你敬佩的探险者或一次冒险:是谁/是什么、故事中最了不起的一点,以及它为何打动你。

lines.text: I just read about Shackleton. What an amazing explorer!
lines.cn: 我刚读了沙克尔顿的故事,真是了不起的探险家!

lines.text: Didn't his ship get crushed by the ice?
lines.cn: 他的船不是被冰压碎了吗?

lines.text: Yes, but he still brought every man home alive.
lines.cn: 是的,但他仍把每个人都活着带回了家。

lines.text: That's true courage. I'd like to read about him too.
lines.cn: 那才是真正的勇气。我也想读读他的故事。

lines.text: I'd love to join a polar expedition one day.
lines.cn: 我真想有朝一日参加一次极地探险。

lines.text: It takes a lot of planning. You can't just set out.
lines.cn: 那需要大量准备,不能贸然出发。

lines.text: Learn to read maps and watch the weather, and always carry a radio.
lines.cn: 学会看地图、留意天气,并随身带无线电。
